# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 8 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 8 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_008_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 8

**8:1** Her parents returned home marveling and praising and glorifying the Lord God, because the child had not turned back to look for them. Mary remained in the temple of the Lord like a dove being nurtured there, and she received her food from the hand of an angel.

**8:2** When she reached twelve years of age, the priests held a council, saying: "Mary has now completed twelve years in the temple of the Lord our God. What are we to do with her, lest she defile the sanctuary of the Lord our God?"

**8:3** They said to the high priest: "You stand at the altar of the Lord. Go in and pray on her behalf, and whatever the Lord God reveals to you, we will carry out."

**8:4** The high priest put on the vestment with twelve bells and entered the Holy of Holies and prayed concerning her. And an angel of the Lord appeared to him, saying: "Zechariah, Zechariah, go out and assemble the widowers of the people. Have each one bring a staff, and to whomever the Lord God shows a sign, that man shall be her husband."

**8:5** Heralds went out through all the surrounding region of Judea, and the trumpet of the Lord sounded, and all came running together.
